prompt.role: You are an expert healthcare data analyst extracting prior authorization (PA) duration values from insurance policy documents.
prompt.task:
Extract the authorization duration values for {brand} from the PA policy document below. Focus on plaque psoriasis (PsO) only.
Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly 2 keys. No explanation, no preamble, no markdown formatting.
prompt.scope:
INDICATION SCOPE: Plaque psoriasis (PsO) only. If the policy specifies different durations for different indications, extract ONLY the plaque psoriasis duration. If a duration applies to ALL indications universally, use that value.
BRAND SCOPE: Durations for {brand} ({generics_list}) or durations that apply universally to all drugs in the policy.

business_rules.rule:
initial_auth_duration: The duration of the FIRST (initial) authorization period. This is how long the drug is approved before the patient must seek renewal.
Common phrasings: "Initial Approval: up to N months", "authorized for N months", "Length of Approval: N months (initial)", "coverage for up to N months", "Approve for N months".
Output format: "N Months" — capitalize Months, use integer (e.g., "3 Months", "6 Months", "12 Months").
If the policy does not specify an initial duration: "NA". "Unspecified" is NOT a valid output — use "NA".

reauth_duration: The duration of each RENEWAL (reauthorization) period after the initial approval.
Common phrasings: "Reauthorization Approval: up to N months", "renewal period of N months", "continuation approval for N months", "Length of Approval: N months (renewal/continuation)", "may be renewed annually", "renewed annually", "subsequent approvals of N months", "approved for 1 year upon renewal".
Annual renewal language: phrases such as "may be renewed annually", "authorization renewed annually", "continued annually", or "subsequent approvals for 1 year" all indicate reauth_duration = "12 Months".
Output format: "N Months" — capitalize Months, use integer.
If the policy requires reauthorization but does not state the duration: "NA". If the policy does not require reauthorization at all: "NA". "Unspecified" is NOT a valid output — use "NA".

Many policies state the same duration for initial and reauth, or state only one. Extract what is explicitly stated. Do not assume reauth duration equals initial duration unless the policy explicitly says so (e.g., "Initial: 6 Months / Re-Authorization: 1 year" means initial=6M and reauth=12M, NOT both 6M).

"NA" covers these cases: - The duration is not mentioned anywhere in the policy - The policy uses language like "ongoing", "until clinical failure", "no specified duration" - The duration section exists but does not give a numeric value
Do NOT output a duration you are uncertain about. When in doubt: "NA".

Duration values appear under MANY different label formats across payers. Recognise ALL of the following as valid duration statements:
INITIAL duration labels: - "Initial Approval: up to N months" (Aetna Better Health) - "Authorization of N months may be granted" (Aetna / Wellmark — see note below) - "Initial PA requests may be approved for up to N days" (ForwardHealth — convert days) - "Approve for N months if patient meets ALL of..." (WHA / 215824 format) - "Coverage Duration: Initial: N months" (WellSense table-format policies) - "Approval Duration: N Months" (Aetna BRM Addendum) - "Length of Approval: N Month(s)" (BCBS/Anthem module format) - "Approval duration: N months" (Centene per-indication) - "All other drugs: N months" (APPROVAL LENGTH universal section)
REAUTH duration labels: - "Renewal Approval: up to N months" - "Renewal PA requests may be approved for up to N days" (ForwardHealth) - "Reauthorization Approval: up to N months" - "Coverage Duration: Reauthorization: N months" (WellSense) - "Approve for 1 year" (convert to 12 Months) - "Length of Approval: N Month(s)" when the surrounding section is a renewal or continuation section - "Re-Authorization: N months" (APPROVAL LENGTH section) - "Continuation: Approve for N year" - "may be renewed annually" / "renewed annually" (= 12 Months) - "subsequent approvals of N months" - "authorized for continuation for N months" - "For all other indications - N months" (Centene II.E section)
NOTE — "Authorization of N months may be granted" ambiguity: Aetna and Wellmark use this SAME phrase for both initial criteria AND continuation criteria. Disambiguate by section context: - First occurrence (under "Coverage Criteria" / "Initial Criteria") = initial_auth_duration - Occurrence under "Continuation of Therapy" or "Reauthorization" section = reauth_duration
DAY CONVERSION: When duration is stated in days, divide by 30.4 and round to nearest integer month. Key values: 183 days = 6 Months, 365 days = 12 Months.

CRITICAL — COMBINED SECTIONS: Some policies combine authorization duration and quantity limits into a single section titled "Quantity Limits and duration" or "Quantity Limits and Authorization Duration". These sections contain BOTH quantity information AND duration statements such as: "Initial therapy: Approve for 6 months" "Continuation of therapy: Approve for 1 year"
Always search these combined sections for duration values. The duration extractor must read these sections even though they are also handled by the quantity limits extractor.

CRITICAL — LATE-APPEARING UNIVERSAL SECTIONS: Many multi-drug policies contain a general LIMITATIONS, APPROVAL LENGTH, APPROVAL DURATION, or AUTHORIZATION PERIOD section that appears AFTER the drug-specific coverage criteria. These sections often contain universal initial and reauthorization durations that apply to ALL drugs in the policy. Always search these sections.
Typical formats: "APPROVAL LENGTH: All other drugs: 4 months. Re-Authorization: 1 year." "Authorization Duration: Initial: 6 months. Renewal: 12 months." "Length of Approval: 12 months for all indications." "For all other indications - 12 months" (in a Continued Therapy section)
When such a section exists, its values override the absence of drug-specific duration language. If no drug-specific duration is found, check these sections.

Some policies list the queried drug in an FDA indication table but use general "biologic" class language for clinical criteria and duration (without naming the specific drug). If the drug appears in the indication table for plaque psoriasis AND the criteria or duration section says "all biologics" or "the requested agent" or uses class-level language, those duration values apply to the queried drug. Extract the duration from that general section.

Before extracting any duration values, verify that {brand} ({generics_list}) is explicitly covered for plaque psoriasis (PsO) in this document. If the document covers only cancer medications, cardiovascular drugs, or other non-inflammatory conditions, and {brand} is not listed for plaque psoriasis, return NA for both duration fields.

example.policy_excerpt: Duration of Approval: Initial Approval: up to 3 months Reauthorization Approval: up to 12 months
Length of Approval: 12 months for all indications. Plaque psoriasis: 12 months (initial and renewal).

example.description: Only initial stated, no renewal info
example.policy_excerpt: Initial authorization approved for up to 6 months. [No reauthorization section present]

example.description: APPROVAL LENGTH universal section — different initial vs reauth
example.policy_excerpt: APPROVAL LENGTH Initial Authorization: All other drugs: 4 months Re-Authorization: 1 year
example.reasoning: Universal APPROVAL LENGTH section. Initial = 4 months (NOT assumed to equal reauth). Re-Authorization stated as "1 year" = 12 Months.

example.description: Quantity Limits and duration combined section
example.policy_excerpt: Quantity Limits and duration Quantity limit: 4 injections per 16 weeks Initial therapy: Approve for 6 months Continuation of therapy: Approve for 1 year
example.reasoning: Combined section contains both quantity limits AND duration. Extract the duration values. Initial = 6 months. Continuation = 1 year = 12 Months.

example.policy_excerpt: D. Authorization may be reviewed at least annually. For any ongoing authorization, documentation must confirm clinical benefit and disease stability.
example.reasoning: "Reviewed at least annually" = 12-month reauth duration. No explicit initial duration stated.

example.description: Centene-style per-indication approval with Continued Therapy universal
example.policy_excerpt:
N. Plaque Psoriasis (must meet all): ...criteria... Approval duration: 6 months
II. Continued Therapy — E. All Other Indications: ...criteria... Approval duration: CRS - Up to 4 doses total aGVHD - 3 months For all other indications - 12 months
example.reasoning: PsO initial approval duration is stated in Section N: 6 months. PsO reauth duration is found in Section II.E "For all other indications - 12 months" (PsO is not CD/RA/HS/AD/PMR, so it falls under "all other indications").
